cards.title: Make busy matchdays reliable
cards.summary: AWS cutover and a quiet-day takeover drill are verified; busy-day reliability remains unmeasured.
cards.acceptance: Measure 99.95% usable scoreboards and 99.9% active observation freshness. Measure provider-visible change to screen separately: p95 ≤30s, p99 ≤60s. Warn after 45s. Missing checks and provider failures count against the user-facing result.
cards.next: Complete independent monitoring, measure public read capacity, then capture busy-matchday SLO evidence.
cards.evidence: AWS production cutover verified October 4. Standby lease takeover in 15.916 seconds; twelve public reads succeeded; PL and CL then published version 5 under epoch 6. Sustained availability and event latency remain unmeasured.

cards.title: External monitoring and approved paging
cards.summary: Local watcher is verified; continuous hosting and real paging remain open.
cards.acceptance: Record both PL and CL, missing observations and worst-fixture freshness independently. Inject an incident and verify delivery to the configured alert receiver plus recovery. Preserve dated evidence.
cards.next: Implement retention and durable receiver delivery; finish external supervision, schedule renewal and independent watchdog pricing.
cards.evidence: fa25837: explicit window handover preserves PL/CL probes while prior alerts retry. 36 related tests pass; focused path tests also pass. Concurrent runners excluded; restart adds no probes or acknowledged deliveries. Hosting and human paging remain uninstalled.

cards.title: Migrate every provider consumer
cards.summary: Worker and Pages read stored AWS data; GitHub provider feeder is skipped.
cards.acceptance: Inventory Worker, GitHub and script consumers; route provider calls through the shared budget and viewers through stored reads. Preserve fantasy, predictions, notifications, accounts and match detail.
cards.next: Complete supplementary history and invalid detail diagnostics within the shared allowance.
cards.evidence: Worker provider key removed; source variable set; feeder run 37219078579 skipped. Fantasy pool publishes 618 unambiguous players with explicit degraded coverage.

cards.title: Move score collection and reads to AWS
cards.summary: Production score feeds now read the Ireland AWS service.
cards.acceptance: Produce infrastructure, monthly cost assumptions, read-only IAM, throttling, egress constraints and rollback. Exercise multi-zone takeover and cold/warm traffic after approval.
cards.next: Measure busy-matchday reliability and public-read capacity; finish independent monitoring.
cards.evidence: Two AZ collectors; controlled stop observed lease takeover within 15.916s, all 12 public read samples passed. Frontend c488c35 and service bb79bf0 deployed. No achieved nines claim. Both leagues subsequently published version 5 under standby epoch 6 at 17:17:49/50 UTC.

cards.title: Verify public score read capacity
cards.summary: Measure visitor load against the AWS 10 RPS / burst 20 ceiling.
cards.acceptance: Exercise representative simultaneous clients plus static exports; meet agreed freshness and availability targets without throttling. Record the load level and cache behavior before claiming capacity.
cards.next: Define the visitor-load target and run bounded stored-read load tests; tune caching and throttling within approved costs.
cards.evidence: Static detail export burst exposed the ceiling during cutover. Export pacing shipped in c488c35; manual export run 37219360105 passed. Visitor-scale load remains unmeasured.

cards.title: Finish fantasy history and match details
cards.summary: Supplementary coverage is incomplete and stopped at the protected score reserve.
cards.acceptance: Collect all three fantasy history seasons without spending the 6000-request score reserve. Prevent invalid archived-detail retries starving history. Expose bounded failure reasons and fixture identities; preserve source age and unknown values.
cards.next: Fix supplementary scheduling and validation diagnostics, then verify stored data and exported fantasy estimates end to end.
cards.evidence: October 4 cutover reached 1500 accounted requests of 7500, reserving 6000 for scores. The 618-player pool reports missing historical coverage; some match details remain partial.

cards.title: Resolve ambiguous provider squad identities
cards.summary: Conflicting player records are excluded instead of inventing a club or position.
cards.acceptance: Keep excluded IDs visible in coverage, preserve valid players, and restore excluded players only when source identity and position agree. Keep exports honest during recovery.
cards.next: Verify provider corrections and validate recovery of the excluded identities.
cards.evidence: Provider player 416250 appeared twice for Aston Villa with conflicting positions. bb79bf0 publishes unambiguous players and records exclusions; regression tests cover within-club and cross-club conflicts.

cards.title: Verify deployed role restrictions
cards.summary: Declared IAM simulations passed; actual denied-operation checks remain open.
cards.acceptance: Under actual deployed roles, prove the reader cannot write score storage or access the provider secret. Confirm collector permissions are limited to the intended resources without changing production data.
cards.next: Prepare bounded, non-mutating runtime permission checks and record explicit denied outcomes.
cards.evidence: Actual AWS reads and collector publication work. Previous declared-policy simulations do not prove runtime denials.

cards.title: Measure real matchday delivery
cards.summary: Establish busy-window evidence instead of inferring reliability from a build.
cards.acceptance: Retain timestamped PL/CL observations and p50/p95/p99 delivery reports; disclose coverage gaps. Verify stale warnings and recovery in headless browser journeys.
cards.next: Select a busy PL/CL match window after independent monitoring is operational; measure the deployed AWS path.
cards.evidence: Synthetic recovery passes; sustained production nines are unknown.
